caseNameFull: Sielaff, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections v. Carrier

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 473 U. S. 903.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Sherman Louis Cohn, Esquire, of Washington, D. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
